About this space

GULF-FRONT in between Alys, Seacrest & Rosemary Beaches! The BEST location! COMPLETELY RENOVATED *updated photos coming soon*

Sleeps 24+ with 8 bedrooms and 7 full+3 half bathrooms!

PRIVATE BEACH with private beach walkover!

Private pool, hot tub, game room with pool table, wet bar, coffee bar, multiple master bedrooms, multiple living areas, kitchenette, indoor fireplace, BBQ grill and porches galore! Separate pool/carriage house!

6 bikes & 6 beach setups complimentary (available March-Oct)

The space

Welcome to 'The Aurelia on the Gulf!'

This gorgeous, Gulf-front retreat offers 3-floors of luxury and stunning Gulf views throughout.

This location cannot be beat, literally ON the beach with its own private beach and beach access, plus walking/biking distance to Alys & Rosemary Beaches for world-class shopping and dining! Located in a private gated community!

On the first floor, you'll find an entertainment space/game room, complete with a pool table, Foosball, a dart board, and a gaming area with a video game console and a TV. There is also an additional separate living area with a TV, along with a kitchenette, half bathroom, laundry room, and two bedrooms. The first bedroom has two Full beds plus two sets of Twin-over-Twin bunk beds (sleeps 8). The second room has two sets of Twin-over-Twin bunk beds (sleeps 4), and a hallway bathroom with a glass shower.

The second floor is truly the heart of the home. The spacious living room features a stunning fireplace and a beautiful built-in wet bar. There is also a separate coffee bar nearby as well. The open-concept floor plan flows seamlessly into the dining area, with a beautiful wooden dining table and an elegant chandelier. Just beyond, the gourmet kitchen is complete with high-end appliances and island seating for four. The expansive second-floor balcony offers ample seating and the best views of the Gulf, and has a private walkover directly to the sand! Also on this floor is another half bathroom, along with the first master bedroom that has a King bed and an en-suite bathroom with a shower/tub combination.

On the third floor, there are four more bedrooms. Two master bedrooms, both with a King bed, a private balcony, and a luxurious en-suite bathroom with dual vanities and a glass shower (and one of them also has a separate soaking tub). The other two bedrooms on this floor both have King beds - one has an en-suite bathroom with a glass shower, and the other uses the hall bathroom with glass shower. The views from 2 of these bedrooms are just stunning!

Outside, enjoy the private heated pool and hot tub with surrounding sun loungers. Adjacent to the pool area there is a BBQ grill and a lovely green space for playing games or hanging out!

Adjacent to the pool, the carriage house boasts its own living area, kitchenette, laundry room, the 8th bedroom, which has a King bed and one set of Twin-over-Twin bunk beds (sleeps 4), a private balcony, and an en-suite bathroom with a glass shower. There is also a half bathroom (pool bath) on the first floor of the carriage house right off of the pool area.

There is parking for up to 4 cars in the driveway!

Just steps to the beach with your own private walkover, you can't get any closer than this! Beach set-ups (6 chairs and 3 umbrellas) are provided complimentary for guests from March-October.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 24 Guests):

FIRST FLOOR
-Game room with pool table, foosball, dart board, and gaming area with console and TV
-Living Area
-Kitchenette
-Laundry Room
-Half Bathroom
-Bedroom 1: Two Full beds and two sets of Twin-over-Twin bunks, shared hallway bathroom with glass shower
-Bedroom 2: Two sets of Twin-over-Twin bunks, shared hallway bathroom with glass shower

SECOND FLOOR
-Living Room
-Dining Room
-Kitchen
-Half Bathroom
-Bedroom 3: (Master): King bed, en-suite bathroom with shower/tub combination

THIRD FLOOR
-Bedroom 4 (Master): King bed, private balcony, en-suite bathroom with dual vanities, glass shower, and separate soaking tub
-Bedroom 5 (Master): King bed, private balcony, en-suite bathroom with dual vanities and a glass shower
-Bedroom 6: King bed, en-suite bathroom with glass shower
-Bedroom 7: King bed, dedicated hallway bathroom with glass shower

CARRIAGE HOUSE
-Living Area
-Kitchenette
-Laundry Room
-Bedroom 8: King bed and one Twin-over-Twin bunk bed, private balcony, en-suite bathroom with glass shower
-Half Bathroom off the pool

There is also a pack n' play at the home for guests' use!

Guest access

Located ON the Gulf/beach on the South side of 30A, this gorgeous home is directly beachfront with PRIVATE deeded beach access! Located on a private gated street. Luxury and privacy!

Enjoy complimentary beach service, which includes a set-up of 6 beach chairs & 3 umbrellas (available March-October). Additional beach chairs may be purchased upon request. Please note that personal beach chairs are permitted.

There are also 6 bikes provided complimentary to guests.

Other things to note
-Pet friendly upon approval. Please inquire for non-refundable pet fee based on breed and size.
-Please note we provide a starter set of supplies such as toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, dishwasher + laundry pods for your stay.
-Check in is 4:00 PM & check out is 10:00 AM. These times are strict and late check out will be subject to another day's rental fees.
-Smoking is strictly prohibited.
-All renters must be over 25 years of age, or if under age 25 must be accompanied by a parent/legal guardian.
-Pool and hot tub/spa heating must be for the full duration of your stay and must be requested 48 hours prior to check-in and paid before the heater will be turned on. Pool heating cost is $50/night of your reservation and is available October 1st - April 30th. After April 30, guests can still heat the spa or hot tub for the same daily rate.
-Damage that occurs will be collected from the renters.
-Southern Holiday Homes can not be held liable for any damage or injury to any persons caused by pool, hot tub, bikes, or other amenities provided to guests.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
